# Verify against acceptance

Load when a request involves any of these terms: verify, tests, constraints, acceptance evidence.

## Step instructions

Run the constraint check command rendered for this work item.
If constraint checks are configured, fix every failed or unverified constraint and
rerun the checks until they pass.

The constraint check results will be saved to: the output path shown in the rendered check command

Review any failure details included with the check output.

Run the narrow tests for what this change touched -- the test file(s) or command
that exercise it, or `python3 -m pytest -n4` scoped to the affected area. Record
facts.acceptance_passed, true only if they are green.

Record facts.acceptance_evidence: the commands you ran and what they printed. The
run cannot tell a test that ran from one that was named, so that text IS the
evidence — it is copied onto the WorkNode.

## Facts

- `acceptance_passed`: Whether the narrow tests for this change are green.
- `acceptance_evidence`: The test commands run and their output. Required to leave this step; persisted on the WorkNode in the generic StepEvidence record.
